description: This file defines transaction-related attributes, enums, and base classes used for managing transactional behavior in the Orleans framework. It includes the TransactionAttribute class for marking methods, TransactionOption enums for configuration, and several abstract request classes that handle transaction lifecycle, responses, and invocation logic.

classes.name: TransactionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute class used to mark methods for transaction management, specifying transaction requirements and options.

classes.name: TransactionOption
classes.description: Enumeration defining transaction behavior options such as Create, Join, Suppress, etc.

classes.name: TransactionOptionAlias
classes.description: Alias enumeration providing alternative names mapped to TransactionOption values.

classes.name: TransactionRequestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for transaction-related requests, managing transaction info, serialization, and invocation logic.

classes.name: TransactionResponse
classes.description: Represents responses from transaction requests, including transaction info and handling of result/error propagation.

classes.name: TransactionRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction request types with no result, providing invocation mechanics.

classes.name: TransactionRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Generic class for transaction requests returning a result, implementing invocation logic.

classes.name: TransactionTaskRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction requests that return a Task<TResult>, optimized for async execution.

classes.name: TransactionTaskRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction requests returning a Task with no result, optimized for async execution.

methods.name: SetTransactionOptions
methods.description: Method to set the transaction options on a request.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main method executing the request, managing transaction lifecycle, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: BaseInvoke
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, executing the actual invocation logic.

methods.name: InvokeInner
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to override with specific invocation implementation.
